title: Fragments of the Greek novels on papyrus: Ninus, Metiochus & Parthenope, Sesonchosis, Iolaus, Lollianus' Phoinikika / «Роман о Нине» и др.
author: Anonymous; Lollianus
edition: Stephens & Winkler 1995 (text + English). Open texts in papyri.info DDbDP (CC BY): https://papyri.info
ru_evidence: ru-wiki 'Роман о Нине' lists only studies (Кузнецова 1969 etc.), no translation. Possible excerpts in Kuznetsova's chapter are unverified.
en_evidence: Stephens & Winkler, Ancient Greek Novels: The Fragments (1995); not re-verified this sweep
value: Earliest Greek fiction, including historical romances (Ninus/Semiramis, Sesonchosis) that parallel the Alexander Romance. Essential for the history of the genre. Short and openly licensed.
ai_feasibility: Medium-low: gappy papyri. AI must mark text vs. supplement precisely, which makes it a good stress test of the review protocol.
pilot_unit: Ninus Romance (P.Berol. 6926 + further papyri; c. 1.5k words est.)
